I can't wait for the fans to see what we're cooking up.|Daniel José Older|<ref name="swidw">{{SW|url=news/idw-star-wars-the-high-republic-adventures-announce|text=Yoda Returns with Another Lesson in IDW's ''Star Wars: The High Republic Adventures''}}</ref>}}
'''''Star Wars: The High Republic Adventures''''' is a comic-book series written by [[Daniel José Older]] as part of the ''[[Star Wars: The High Republic]]'' multimedia project. The series focuses on a group of [[Padawan]]s traveling [[the galaxy]] to learn the ways of the [[Jedi]], being mentored by [[Yoda]].<ref name="Meet Yoda">{{SW|url=news/inside-star-wars-the-high-republic-meet-yoda|text=Inside ''Star Wars: The High Republic'': Meet Yoda}}</ref> It was published by [[IDW Publishing]]<ref name="The High Republic" /> and began on [[February 3]], [[2021]].<ref name="Issue 1" /> The series concluded a year later with its [[The High Republic Adventures (2021) 13|13th issue]] on [[February 23]], [[2022]],<ref name="Issue 13" /> receiving a [[Starlight Coda|coda]] through the [[Free Comic Book Day 2023: All Ages]] one-shot in [[2023]].<ref name="FCBD">{{WebCite|url=https://freecomicbookday.com/Article/265288|text=Full Line-Up of FCBD 2023 Comic Books Announced!|date=2022-11-17|archivedate=20221117191032}}</ref>
